content: धरण {%a.%} (-णी|{%f.%}) [धृ-युच्] Bearing, preserving, holding <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-णः@} .²1 A ridge of land serving the purpose of a bridge; the side of a mountain. .²2 The world. .²3 The sun. .²4 The female breast. .²5 Rice, corn. .²6 The Himālaya (as king of mountains). .²7 A dike, bank. .{@-णम@} .²1 Supporting, sustaining, upholding; सारं धरित्रीधरणक्षमं च <ls>Ku. 1. 17</ls>; धरणिधरणकिणचक्रगरिष्ठे <ls>Gīt. 1</ls>. .²2 Possessing, bringing, procuring, <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 Prop, stay, support. .²4 Security. .²5 A measure of weight equal to ten {%palas%}; पलं सुवर्णाश्चत्वारः पलानि धरणं दश <ls>Ms. 8. 135</ls>.
